Get, set and reset micropubr defaults

Source: R/mp_options.R
mp_set_defaults.Rd

micropubr reads a small set of package-wide defaults that every mp_*() plotting function falls back to when the corresponding argument is left at its default (NULL). Setting them once with mp_set_defaults() gives every subsequent plot a consistent look without repeating arguments.

Usage

mp_set_defaults(
  font.size = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  verbose = NULL,
  guardrails = NULL
)

mp_get_defaults()

mp_reset_defaults()

Arguments

font.size

Base font size in points used by the default theme.

palette

A palette name (see mp_palette()) or an explicit vector of colours used whenever a function's palette argument is NULL.

theme

A ggplot2 theme object used whenever a function's theme argument is NULL. If NULL, mp_theme_publication() is used.

verbose

Logical; print the underlying method and parameters.

guardrails

How statistical caveats are reported: "warn" (the default) raises a warning of class micropubr_guardrail, "caption" appends a "Note:" line to the figure caption, "off" stays silent. The caveats are recorded either way and listed by mp_methods(). They flag group sizes below 5, richness compared across more than 10-fold differences in sequencing depth, a significant PERMANOVA accompanied by unequal dispersions (PERMDISP), differential-abundance methods that ignored the requested covariates, and covariates so strongly associated with the grouping that adjusting for them is unstable.

Value

mp_get_defaults() returns the current defaults as a named list; mp_set_defaults() and mp_reset_defaults() return the (updated) defaults invisibly.

Examples

old <- mp_get_defaults()
mp_set_defaults(font.size = 9, palette = "okabe")
mp_get_defaults()
#> $font.size
#> [1] 9
#> 
#> $palette
#> [1] "okabe"
#> 
#> $theme
#> NULL
#> 
#> $verbose
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $guardrails
#> [1] "warn"
#> 
mp_reset_defaults()
